description: This file defines a utility class 'LibraryLoader' within the 'Utils' namespace, which handles dynamic library loading and object creation via dlopen and dlsym. It includes methods for loading libraries and creating shared objects, and manages the library handle lifecycle.

classes.name: LibraryLoader
classes.description: A class that manages dynamic loading of shared libraries and creation of objects from them.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a shared library from a specified path and reports errors if any.

methods.name: CreateShared
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an object of type T by invoking a factory function 'Create' from the loaded library.
